materials.title: The train in the shop window
materials.text:

When he left, he thanked us for letting him look closely. He did not buy the train, but he returned the next week with his ____5____. His wheels were beautifully detailed.

I had wanted every passer-by to become a ____6____. Now I saw that a shop window could also begin a conversation. We should not, however, ____7____ what an item could do. materials.title: The instrument in the cupboard
materials.text:

We practised ____7____ ten minutes, then changed roles. It was difficult to listen and play at the same time, but nobody had to learn a long piece from memory. By the end, our group could begin and stop together.

materials.title: Posters at the bus shelter

materials.title: The wrapper as well as the chocolate
